s3_public_access.recommendation: Enable S3 Block Public Access and remove public ACL/policy permissions.

s3_encryption_disabled.issue: S3 bucket encryption is not enabled.
s3_encryption_disabled.recommendation: Enable default encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) on the bucket.

unable_validate_s3_public.issue: Unable to validate S3 public access.
unable_validate_s3_public.recommendation: Review bucket ACL/policy permissions and scanner IAM permissions.

unable_validate_s3_encryption.recommendation: Review scanner IAM permissions for encryption checks.

unable_validate_s3_list.recommendation: Verify s3:ListAllMyBuckets permission for scanner identity.

iam_over_permissive.recommendation: Apply least privilege and remove wildcard action/resource permissions.

iam_inactive_credentials.recommendation: Remove inactive credentials and rotate active credentials regularly.

unable_validate_iam_permissions.recommendation: Review iam:Get* and iam:List* permissions for scanner identity.

unable_validate_iam_list.recommendation: Ensure scanner has IAM list permissions.

ec2_sg_open_critical_ports.issue: EC2 security group exposes critical ports to the internet.
ec2_sg_open_critical_ports.recommendation: Restrict inbound rules on 22, 3389, 80, and 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

unable_validate_ec2_sg.issue: Unable to validate EC2 security group rules.

cloudtrail_not_enabled.recommendation: Create at least one multi-region trail and enable logging.

cloudtrail_logging_disabled.recommendation: Enable logging for the CloudTrail trail.

unable_validate_cloudtrail_status.issue: Unable to validate CloudTrail logging status.

unable_validate_ec2_advanced_list.issue: Unable to list EC2 instances for advanced checks.

ec2_no_iam_instance_profile.issue: EC2 instance has no IAM instance profile attached.
ec2_no_iam_instance_profile.recommendation: Attach an instance profile with least-privilege IAM role for workloads that need AWS API access.

ec2_sg_all_protocols_public.issue: EC2 security group allows all protocols from the internet.
ec2_sg_all_protocols_public.recommendation: Restrict inbound rules; avoid 0.0.0.0/0 with all protocols (-1).

ec2_sg_nonstandard_ports_public.issue: EC2 security group exposes non-standard TCP ports to the internet.
ec2_sg_nonstandard_ports_public.recommendation: Restrict public ingress to required ports only; use VPN or private connectivity.

unable_validate_ec2_advanced_sg.issue: Unable to validate EC2 security groups (advanced).

ec2_ebs_unencrypted.recommendation: Enable encryption by default for new volumes; migrate sensitive data to encrypted volumes.

unable_validate_ec2_volumes.issue: Unable to list EBS volumes for encryption check.

unable_validate_cloudtrail_advanced_list.issue: Unable to list CloudTrail trails for advanced checks.

cloudtrail_advanced_no_trails.issue: No CloudTrail trails exist for advanced configuration checks.
cloudtrail_advanced_no_trails.recommendation: Create an organization or account trail with logging enabled.

cloudtrail_not_multi_region.issue: No multi-region CloudTrail trail is configured.
cloudtrail_not_multi_region.recommendation: Enable IsMultiRegionTrail for at least one trail to capture activity in all regions.

cloudtrail_no_cloudwatch_logs.issue: CloudTrail trail is not integrated with CloudWatch Logs.
cloudtrail_no_cloudwatch_logs.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch Logs log group delivery for real-time monitoring and alarms.

cloudtrail_missing_s3_bucket.issue: CloudTrail trail has no S3 bucket configured.
cloudtrail_missing_s3_bucket.recommendation: Associate a dedicated S3 bucket with appropriate bucket policy for log delivery.

cloudtrail_s3_bucket_no_access_logging.issue: S3 bucket used by CloudTrail has server access logging disabled.
cloudtrail_s3_bucket_no_access_logging.recommendation: Enable server access logging on the log bucket to an isolated logging bucket.

unable_validate_cloudtrail_s3_logging.issue: Unable to validate S3 access logging for CloudTrail bucket.
unable_validate_cloudtrail_s3_logging.recommendation: Verify s3:GetBucketLogging and bucket location permissions for the scanner.

trivy_cli_missing.issue: Trivy CLI not found in PATH.
trivy_cli_missing.recommendation: Install Trivy or set TRIVY_BINARY to the executable path.

trivy_scan_timeout.recommendation: Retry with a narrower target or increase scanner timeout.

trivy_scan_failed.recommendation: Review Trivy stderr/stdout and target configuration.

trivy_json_parse_error.issue: Could not parse Trivy JSON output.

trivy_vulnerability_critical.issue: Trivy reported a critical container or dependency vulnerability.
trivy_vulnerability_critical.recommendation: Upgrade affected packages or rebuild images from patched base images.

trivy_vulnerability_high.recommendation: Patch dependencies or replace vulnerable components.

trivy_vulnerability_low.recommendation: Track and remediate as part of standard patching.

trivy_vulnerability_unknown.issue: Trivy reported a vulnerability with unknown severity.
trivy_vulnerability_unknown.recommendation: Review Trivy output manually and prioritize by CVE context.

trivy_no_vulnerabilities_reported.issue: Trivy reported no vulnerabilities for this target.
trivy_no_vulnerabilities_reported.recommendation: Continue periodic scanning; confirm target scope is correct.

stratus_json_unexpected_shape.issue: Stratus results JSON has an unexpected structure.
stratus_json_unexpected_shape.recommendation: Provide a list or object with techniques/results per integration docs.

stratus_technique_executed.issue: Stratus Red Team technique executed or succeeded in results file.
stratus_technique_executed.recommendation: Review blast radius and remediate detections in production accounts.

stratus_technique_recorded.issue: Stratus Red Team technique recorded in results file.
stratus_technique_recorded.recommendation: Validate whether the activity was authorized and update detection coverage.

stratus_results_file_missing.issue: Stratus results JSON path does not exist.
stratus_results_file_missing.recommendation: Pass a valid --stratus-results-json path or STRATUS_RESULTS_JSON env var.

stratus_results_read_error.issue: Could not read Stratus results JSON.
stratus_results_read_error.recommendation: Verify file permissions and JSON encoding.

stratus_results_empty.issue: Stratus results file contained no technique entries.
stratus_results_empty.recommendation: Export results from Stratus after running approved scenarios.

stratus_cli_error.issue: Stratus CLI list command failed or timed out.
stratus_cli_error.recommendation: Verify Stratus installation and non-interactive usage from PATH.

stratus_cli_available.recommendation: Run only approved simulations in isolated environments; export JSON for this scanner.

stratus_not_configured.issue: Stratus CLI not found and no results JSON provided.
stratus_not_configured.recommendation: Install Stratus Red Team or supply --stratus-results-json.

pacu_json_unexpected_shape.issue: Pacu results JSON has an unexpected structure.
pacu_json_unexpected_shape.recommendation: Export findings as a list of objects with module/details fields.

pacu_finding_high.recommendation: Review IAM and service configurations; reduce excess permissions.

pacu_finding_recorded.recommendation: Triage Pacu output in a controlled environment only.

pacu_results_file_missing.issue: Pacu results JSON path does not exist.

pacu_results_read_error.issue: Could not read Pacu results JSON.
pacu_results_read_error.recommendation: Verify export format and file permissions.

pacu_results_empty.issue: Pacu results file contained no module entries.
pacu_results_empty.recommendation: Run Pacu in an authorized lab and export structured results.

pacu_cli_hint.issue: Pacu CLI detected; interactive scans are not executed automatically.
pacu_cli_hint.recommendation: Export JSON findings and pass --pacu-results-json for standardized reporting.

pacu_not_configured.issue: Pacu not found and no results JSON provided.
pacu_not_configured.recommendation: Install Pacu in a sandbox or provide exported JSON results.
